prompt:
Use case: identity-preserve. Edit the supplied NPC concept sheet for a revised visual approval mockup. Preserve its detailed hand-painted retro fantasy rendering, warm light, material textures, character identity, exact wardrobe and colors, and layout: four full standing cardinal views (front, screen-left profile, back, screen-right profile) and one larger expression portrait at right. Preserve transparent background, full bodies, same scale and baseline, clear gutters. No labels, text, extra figures, props or scenery. Apply the requested anatomical revision coherently to all views including portrait. This is a targeted refinement, not a new character design.
Requested revision: Boric stays a tall thin gawky teenage human guard, hunched with long limbs, undersized helmet and green padded tunic. Keep his long narrow face, slightly vacant slow-to-understand look and slack lips, but make facial proportions plausibly human and much less caricatured. Keep a visible but MILD underbite: shorten lower-jaw projection substantially, reduce heavy lip and gum exposure, use a modest loosely open mouth instead of a huge gaping opening. Teeth normal-sized and mostly intact, slight unevenness and at most one small gap, no row of huge isolated pegs. Eyes naturally spaced and normally aligned, gently unfocused. Reduce extreme face elongation somewhat, retain youthful smooth skin, no wrinkles or aged cheeks. Awkward and dim-looking through expression and posture, not grotesque, monstrous or medically exaggerated.
